settings.subtitle: Button up your comfort: a clean, compact multi-purpose chair with a supportive backrest and four base configurations for dining, living and home-office rooms.
Button up your comfort
settings.heading: BUTTON
settings.alt: SIDIZ BUTTON chairs in a living space
settings.description:
The SIDIZ BUTTON is a multi-purpose interior chair whose clean, uncluttered design settles naturally into any room - dining space, living room or home office.

Compact in form yet steady in backrest support and comfortable to sit in, it is a design chair that satisfies both the look of a space and the use of it.

settings.heading: Support that steadies the body
settings.description: Knowing chairs matters; studying bodies matters as much. The BUTTON's ergonomic stability holds you firmly, for comfort that stays.
settings.alt: The BUTTON supporting an upright sit

settings.title: Flexibility that holds through any movement
settings.description: Elasticity built into the material absorbs the lean and flexes as posture changes, keeping the body's load minimal.

settings.title: A backrest hole that suits every posture
settings.description: A design point that lets any build adjust their position at will, adding comfort to whatever posture the moment calls for.

settings.title: A backrest at the right height
settings.description: High enough to support the upper back comfortably, low enough never to crowd the table it pairs with.
settings.alt: The BUTTON's backrest height at the table

settings.title: A generous seat
settings.description: Roomy enough to sit cross-legged in comfort.

settings.title: 4-Legs
settings.description: The most classic build, easy to style. Steel for durability, with a slim line running to the floor for visual openness.

settings.title: Height adjustable
settings.description: Set the height to different builds and tables, and swivel freely for a wider range of movement.

settings.title: Glide option
settings.description: Fixed steadily in place for a sit without wobble.

settings.title: Castor option
settings.description: Soft castors move freely and make it easy to reset your posture.

settings.title: Plastic finish
settings.description: A refined dot-pattern plastic that keeps care easy and blends into any interior.

settings.title: Fabric finish
settings.description: Fabric adds warmth to the BUTTON's design language, and the backrest cover removes easily for a change of look.
settings.alt: The fabric finish with its removable cover

BUTTON | 5-year warranty
settings.body: So the journey with your BUTTON continues, SIDIZ provides a 5-year warranty to customers who complete product registration. Once your chair arrives, register it before you forget, for more comfortable years ahead.

settings.heading: BUTTON dimensions
settings.figures: Maximum load 112-125 kg depending on the base; product weight approximately 8.9-9.3 kg.
settings.caveats:
*Measurements may vary by plus or minus 20 mm and 1 kg depending on where and how they are taken; this is not a fault.
*Dimensions are measured with nobody seated.
*Seat height is measured at the centre of the seat.

settings.title: Removing stains from the frame
settings.body: If the frame gets marked, a melamine sponge lifts stains easily. *Rubbing hard can damage the surface.

settings.question: I bought castors - can I switch to glides?
settings.answer: Yes, castors and fixed glides interchange - contact our support team to arrange it. Note the chair's height changes with the swap, and on the 4-legs frame the leg frames differ between castor and glide fittings, so the frames swap too.
